channel.title: Doc Radar
channel.description: Upcoming documentary releases from the distributors, broadcasters, streamers and sales agents that matter. Updated weekly.

item.title: The Last Lighthouse Keeper (Dogwoof, NEON)
item.description: Directed by Aoife Brennan. Forty years alone on a rock in the Atlantic, and the month the light finally goes automatic.

item.title: The Seed Vault Opens (ESPN Films / 30 for 30)
item.description: Directed by Kristin Vang. Svalbard makes its first significant withdrawal, and the reasons are not the ones anyone planned for.

item.title: Everything We Threw Away (BBC Storyville)
item.description: Directed by Marcus Vale. A landfill archaeologist reads the twentieth century out of a hundred metres of compacted rubbish.

item.title: Quiet Car (Cinema Guild)
item.description: Directed by Danny Okonjo. Filmed entirely in the silent carriage of the 06:12, over four years of commuters.

item.title: Hold Music (NEON)
item.description: Directed by Tom Devereux. The composers who write the loops you hear on hold, and what they think about all day.

item.title: Cobalt (Greenwich Entertainment)
item.description: Directed by Jean-Luc Mbeki. The supply chain behind every battery on earth, traced backwards from a Dublin car park to a hillside in Katanga.

item.title: The Understudy (Hulu / Onyx Collective, HBO Documentary Films)
item.description: Directed by Petra Lang. She covered the role for nineteen years and went on twice. This is about the other nights.

item.title: The Forger Who Confessed (National Geographic Documentary Films)
item.description: Directed by Elke Brandt. He fooled six museums, then spent thirty years trying to prove it, and nobody wanted to hear.

item.title: Weight Class
item.description: Directed by Nadia Haddad. Three fighters, one scale, and the eleven hours between the weigh-in and the bell.

item.title: Notes on a Vanishing Language (HBO Documentary Films)
item.description: Directed by Sile Ni Chonaill. Three of the last eleven fluent speakers agree to be recorded. Two change their minds.

item.title: Salt Road
item.description: Directed by Ibrahim Toure. A caravan crossing that has run for eight hundred years makes what may be its final journey.

item.title: After the Flood Came the Map (MUBI, Netflix)
item.description: Directed by Rosa Iglesias. A village redraws its own boundaries after the water refuses to leave.
